Map the information flow

Decide what information needs to move, why it is needed and which system should own it.

Choose a supported connection

Marketplace apps, APIs and webhooks can support agreed data flows. A webhook is a system connection, not a customer messaging channel.

Confirm the operational detail

Check access, security, data handling, provider subscriptions, maintenance and usage costs. Mobile access varies by app and feature.

Capability scope

Connect the way your team works.

Bring supported tools into your process and keep everyday customer work accessible when your team is away from a desk.

  • Supported account and marketplace connections
  • APIs and webhooks for agreed data flows
  • Mobile access to supported CRM features

API access, app subscriptions and custom integration work depend on your plan and requirements. Mobile features vary by app.

Built around an agreed setup.
